entries.classification_evidence: Q0, Q1 and Q2 GREEN on windows 3.11 (Q0-Q3 GREEN on every ubuntu job); Q3 UNRUNNABLE on windows only: 400 cases passed, 16 not applicable, 0 failed, and one case (tests.v2.p4.test_process_range Range.test_an_escaped_child_is_detected_reported_and_never_signalled) skipped with 'a job without BREAKAWAY_OK has no way out; escaped() is empty there' — the Windows Job Object's own semantics (no member can leave the job), a platform inapplicability the harness did not recognise because the reason names the job, not the platform. A defect of the harness's reading (validation/qualification/common.py); every fault, race, watchdog and wait-contract measurement on that job held; the kernel tree is unchanged. Recorded only for its local gate and this qualification run here; its tests run 36281429107 was still in progress and is appended by the next evidence-writing commit.
